description: Managed device driver for the Global Cache IP2CC.
author: symetrix

notes: New standard panel: Global Cache header, stock Cognio controls.
Connect Offline replaces the Connect button: online the driver always connects; offline it connects only while Connect Offline is on.
Connected (was Online) lights only after the unit answers, relay states are sent once it does, and a unit that stops answering is dropped and retried.
